company.description: Ostafandy is a smart personal assistant for clients, handymen, and engineers that enhances and optimizes their capability to finish any home improvement project effectively at high quality and low cost with a "pay as you go" model. Ostafandy system includes a smart quote using our invented algorithmic pricing engine, in which clients can understand the services' minor and major details, prices, and instantly issue digital bills; hence, quoting and paying seamlessly. This algorithmic pricing engine can adapt easily to any new market with a high level of accuracy regarding the market's dynamicity.
